items.en: I get upset with myself for having feelings that don't make sense.
items.zh_working: 我会为自己有一些说不通的情绪而生自己的气。

items.en: At school, I walk from class to class without noticing what I'm doing.
items.zh_working: 在学校里，我从一个教室走到另一个教室，却没留意自己在做什么。

items.en: I keep myself busy so I don't notice my thoughts or feelings.
items.zh_working: 我让自己忙个不停，好不去注意自己的想法或感受。

items.en: I tell myself that I shouldn't feel the way I'm feeling.
items.zh_working: 我告诉自己，我不应该有现在这种感受。

items.en: I push away thoughts that I don't like.
items.zh_working: 我把不喜欢的想法推开。

items.en: It's hard for me to pay attention to only one thing at a time.
items.zh_working: 我很难一次只专注于一件事。

items.en: I get upset with myself for having certain thoughts.
items.zh_working: 我会为自己有某些念头而生自己的气。

items.en: I think about things that have happened in the past instead of thinking about things that are happening right now.
items.zh_working: 我总想着过去发生的事，而不是留意当下正在发生的事。

items.en: I think that some of my feelings are bad and that I shouldn't have them.
items.zh_working: 我觉得有些情绪是不好的，我不应该有它们。

items.en: I stop myself from having feelings that I don't like.
items.zh_working: 我阻止自己产生不喜欢的情绪。

scores.label: 正念总分（10题，反向后）
scores.description: 按官方规则先逐题反向（0↔4、1↔3、2 不变）再求和，范围 0–40。分数越高表示越多报告“留意当下、允许感受存在”；分数越低表示越多报告走神、评判自己或推开感受。方向与题目字面相反，解读时以本说明为准。

missingPolicy: complete_required；任一题缺失则该分数不计算，不插补、不补0。
